calls.title: Johnny/Kari
calls.summary: The meeting centered on refining the checklist panel design to enhance visibility and usability during experiments. It was decided to relocate the checklist for better workflow, as the original placements conflicted with user behavior. The team agreed to remove unnecessary comment functions and opted for a compact panel with a dark mode color scheme, despite contrast limitations. Discussions also covered the integration of alert elements within the UI to manage user awareness of incomplete tasks. Additionally, the team emphasized user empowerment by allowing them to start experiments despite incomplete checklist items. Thorough documentation was highlighted as essential for future reference and alignment between design and engineering workflows. Plans were made to continue work on the design system and component development after the break.
calls.keywords: checklist design, experiment workflow, UI/UX challenges, feature flags, manual vs automated tasks, design documentation
